analyst.summary: KRN Heat Exchanger makes thermal components for air-conditioning and refrigeration equipment, and has grown revenue and profit strongly over the past year, helped by rising AC demand and new order wins. But the reported profit growth has not been matched by cash generation -- free cash flow was sharply negative this past year, funded by a jump in borrowings, and both receivables and inventory have been building up faster than sales. The promoter also recently sold a meaningful block of shares. All of this sits underneath a very expensive valuation. We rate it a Hold, but are flagging the combination of cash-flow weakness, working-capital deterioration and recent promoter selling for portfolio-manager attention rather than treating this as a routine call.
